profile_description: 有点瘪，心意没瘪。林小羊陪你接住日常的小情绪，慢慢来，也好好回应。

albums.name: 上班有点咩
albums.desc: 人到工位，精神慢慢加载。开会、改稿、下班，让林小羊替你轻轻吐个槽。
albums.cover: One sheep sagging over a tiny plain laptop, tired face with one little hoof lifted, full seated body visible. Compact single silhouette, laptop small enough not to hide face.
albums.banner: A continuous cozy office afternoon scene, three instances of the SAME sheep: left drooping over a laptop at a small desk, middle slowly holding a short stack of blank papers, right already sprawled on a floor cushion with a little bag, tired but gentle. Muted sky blue backdrop with a few minimal office shapes, no panels.

albums.name: 工作接得住
albums.desc: 收到、处理中、一起对齐。用清楚又柔软的回应，接住工作里的每一次协作。
albums.cover: One sheep sitting upright but softly squishy, holding a small plain sage-green clipboard against belly and raising a hoof in a calm acknowledgment. Full body, friendly attentive eyes.
albums.banner: A continuous collaborative workspace with three instances of SAME sheep: left receives a plain folder, center checks a small laptop, right hands over a tidy blank document with a reassuring nod. Simple rounded shared table, muted sage-green background, calm attentive cooperative gestures.

albums.name: 羊毛失控
albums.desc: 脑袋打结，羊毛出走。裂开、变饼、突然弹起，把说不清的状态交给这团羊毛。
albums.cover: One sheep has comically flattened into a low fluffy pancake, both curled horns and droopy ears intact, tiny deadpan face looking forward, one little hoof sticking up. A single readable sheep with no floating duplicate faces.
albums.banner: A continuous playful lilac space showing three instances of SAME sheep in elastic absurd states: left very flat pancake still looking at viewer, middle wool body gently twisted like a soft knot with normal single face and two horns, right joyfully springing upward with stretched body. Few tiny motion dashes, no confetti clutter.

albums.name: 年会轮到我
albums.desc: 上台有点慌，鼓掌很在行。陪你排练、等抽奖、开吃，也认真说一句今晚辛苦啦。
albums.cover: One sheep sitting forward eagerly holding a small sealed coral-red gift box with simple gold ribbon, shy expectant eyebrows, full body with short hooves.
albums.banner: A continuous friendly office year-end party, three instances of SAME sheep: left shy with a microphone, center seated clapping supportively, right hugging a wrapped gift near a small dining table. Warm peach and apricot background, a few simple rounded gold stage lights and a short fabric garland. No words, no numbers.

albums.name: 热梗动起来
albums.desc: 爱你老己，也偶尔没招。让林小羊把熟人聊天里的夸张反应，演给你看。
albums.cover: One sheep gently hugging its OWN soft wool belly with both hooves, a fond crooked little smile, body squashed into a rounded seated shape. No objects, readable self-hug.
albums.banner: A continuous playful lime-sage lounging scene with three instances of SAME sheep: left fondly hugging its own fluffy body, middle exuberantly bouncing with two little raised hooves, right exhausted and flat beside a tiny handmade cardboard shape. Expressive soft-body contrast, simple calm green background, sparse small motion marks.

albums.name: 日常有回应
albums.desc: 出门报一声，到家回一句。吃饭、休息、晚安，让平常日子里的回应软一点。
albums.cover: One sheep with a tiny muted teal shoulder bag, waving one hoof gently, slouchy seated full-body pose with friendly tired smile. No travel landmarks.
albums.banner: A continuous day-to-night cozy neighborhood vignette, three instances of SAME sheep: left setting out with a little shoulder bag beside a simple rounded doorway, middle sitting with a steaming bowl at a small table, right resting against a lavender pillow beneath a tiny crescent moon motif. Muted turquoise backdrop, flat illustrative space not separate panels.

albums.name: 羊年一起过
albums.desc: 拜年接福，红包认真谢，团圆饭慢慢吃。林小羊陪你把羊年过得暖乎乎。
albums.cover: One sheep wearing a small muted vermilion scarf, holding a plain red envelope with NO writing, gently bowing with forehooves together. Full seated body, joyful but shy.
albums.banner: A continuous Chinese Spring Festival gathering with three instances of SAME sheep: left in a small red scarf offering a polite clasped-hoof New Year greeting, center appreciatively holding a plain red envelope, right inviting everyone toward a small round table with home-style dishes. Warm terracotta red backdrop, two simple red lanterns with golden trim, warm gold accents. NO Chinese characters, no writing on envelopes or lanterns.

albums.name: 和你黏一会
albums.desc: 想你就贴贴，累了就抱抱。约饭、陪伴、和好、晚安，把喜欢放进日常的小回应。
albums.cover: Exactly TWO sheep cuddling cheek-to-cheek while seated, left is Lin Xiaoyang no accessories, right is same-style partner with muted sage-green scarf. Two clearly distinct heads, four horns total, no extra limbs. Compact balanced two full-body figures, affectionate relaxed.
albums.banner: A continuous intimate cozy room with exactly TWO sheep. Left is Lin Xiaoyang with no accessories, right partner wears a muted sage-green scarf. They sit shoulder-to-shoulder on a soft floor cushion, gently leaning cheeks together while one offers the other a little strawberry cake on a small plate. A tiny low table with two tea cups and a lavender pillow nearby, warm muted dusty rose backdrop. Keep this quiet everyday affection, no gender stereotypes, no text.
